question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Mu kibiina ky’Olulimi n’Empuliziganya, mu kibiina eky’okuna, omusomesa aleeta ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga “Okuwandiika ebiwandiiko ebiwa amakulu okusobola okubuulira abantu ku nsonga”. Okukola kino, abayizi balonda omutwe ogubasanyusa era banonye, basome, era bawandiike ebikulu ku mutwe ogwo. Omusomesa awa buli muyizi eky'okulabirako ekiraga omutwe gw’ensonga okusobola okukungaanya ebirowoozo ebikulu okuva mu biwandiiko bye basomye. Omukodyo ogwogeddwa waggulu gutuukana butya n’ekitundu ki mu kuwandiika?
answer_a: Okukyusaamu
answer_b: Okukyusaamu
answer_c: Okuteekateeka
answer_d: Okuteekateeka ebiwandiiko

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. Mukusooka, bali bakusoma kinnomu atte mukasirise, oluvanyumma, baatule, nga bagoberera obubonero obwempandika. Kika ki eky'okuyiga ekifuna mu mu bikolwa ebilagiddwa?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Ku kikwata ku ngeri amagezi gyegafunibwamu abanonyereza ku mpisa z'abantu me eby'okuyiga ebikwatagana n'ennono z'obuwangwa n'embeera z'abantu byawukana bitya?
answer_a: Enneeyisa ey’obwongo egamba nti omwana azimba okumanya ng’ayita mu kugezaako n’okukola ensobi, ate enneyisa ey’embeera z’abantu ekola bw’etyo ng’eyita mu kwegattika.
answer_b: Enneeyisa ey’obwongo (Behaviorism) eraga nti endowooza zifunibwa okuyita mu nkyukakyuka mu bwongo, ate mu ssomero ly’ebyembeera n’ennono (sociocultural theory), zifunibwa okuyita mu nkola y’okutereeza.
answer_c: Enneeyisa ey’obukulembeze (Behaviorism) eraga nti okumanya kutuukibwako okuyita mu kukuuma, ate nga omulamwa gwa sociocultural gukozesa nnyo okuyita mu mbeera y’obuntu.
answer_d: Enneeyisa ey’obwongo eraga nti okutegeera ensi kutuukibwako okuyita mu nkola z’obwongo, ate ng’enjigiriza y’embeera z’abantu n’ennono ekkaatiriza okukoppa.

question: Okusinziira ku bigambo by’ennyingo ya Vygotsky ey’embeera z’abantu n’ennono zaabwe, ki ku bino wammanga ekiraga omulimu omusomesa gw’alina okukola munda mu kibiina?
answer_a: Ateekateeka n'okutegeka ebyo ebisobozesa abayizi okukulaakulanya obusobozi bwabwe obw'okulowooza n'okukulaakulanya obukugu obw'omugaso.
answer_b: Atondawo emirimu egigatta abayizi gy'akola ng'omutabaganya wakati w'okumanya kw'abayizi n'engeri gye bakozesaamu okumanya okwo.
answer_c: Awa abayizi okumanya okutegekeddwa era n’akulaakulanya engeri ze nga yeeyambisa okunyweza n’okulung’amya ebintu.
answer_d: Ateeseteese emirimu mu ngeri entegeke obulungi era ey'omugendo nga bukyali ekimuyamba okukwata ku ngeri abayizi gye balowoozaamu n'engeri gye bayinza okukyusibwamu

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Omukulu w'essomero akola n'omuyizi w'ekibiina ey'omusanvu atandise okukola n'omuyizi alina obulemu ku bwongo. Ebizibu ebisinga obunene byekuusa ku kujjukira ebyo ebiba byakayigibwa, okussaayo omwoyo n'okuteekateeka, so ng'ate waliwo n'ebizibu ebirala ebirabibwa mu kusoma n'okuwandiika. Bwe tulowooza ku ngeri ez'enjawulo ez'okuyigirizaamu n'engeri omuyizi gy'ayinza okuyigamu, ngeri ki ezisinga obukulu okulowoozaako ng'oteekateeka eby'okuyiga?
answer_a: Embeera n'okwenyigiramu
answer_b: Okwenyigiramu n'enneeyisa ey'okukyukakyuka
answer_c: Obukugu mu birowoozo n'okwenyigiramu kintu
answer_d: Obukugu mu bwongo n’enneeyisa ey'okukyukakyuka

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Martin mwana muwere ow’emyaka omusanvu, omuyizi mu kibiina eky’okubiri era alina obulemu bw’obwongo. Ttiimu y’omu kibiina emukolako, ekkaanya ku nkulaakulana ye mu mwaka gwonna ogw’essomero era bakizuula nti newankubadde enkyukakyuka mu kusomesa n’obuyambi obumuweereddwa, omuyizi takulaakulana nga bwe kyasuubirwa. Lwakuba lweno lwenaaba bagenda okusisinkana famire ye era bateese enteekateeka y’omulimu ogw’awamu wakati w’enjuyi zombi (famire n’essomero). Okusinziira ku kitongole kya American Association on Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (AAIDD), nkola ki ku zino wammanga ekulembedde mu mulimu gwa ttiimu y’omu kibiina kya Martin ne famire ye?
answer_a: Enzirukanya y'ebintu ebiri wabweru w'enkola y'obulamu
answer_b: enkwatagana wakati w'embeera ez'enjawulo ez'obuntu (microsystems) omuntu mw'abeerera
answer_c: Enkwatagana wakati w'embeera ez'enjawulo ez'obuntu
answer_d: Omutendera ogusookerwako (Microsystem)

question:
Soma embeera eno:
Omusomesa mu pulayimale ennyumannyuma amaze wiiki eziwerako ng’akolera ku kiruubirirwa kino: "Okuyiga ku bulamu bw’abakyala n’abasajja abamu, mu biseera ebyayita n’ebya kati, abakoze ebitundu eby’enjawulo mu kitundu kyabwe, eggwanga lyabwe, n’ensi yonna, okuyita mu ngero oba n’obuyambi bw’ebyuma bya ICT." Okukebera ekiruubirirwa kino, omusomesa yatunuulidde empisa zonna ez’abayizi era n’asaba abalabirizi b’abaana okulonda omuntu omu eyakiikirira ebyafaayo bya Chile era bayambe abaana baabwe okuyiga ebikulu basobole oluvannyuma okukola omuzannyo gwa leediyo, buli omu gy’akwata omulimu ogumusobozesa okwogera ku byafaayo by’abantu abaalondeddwa.
Omusomesa atunuulira omulimu guno ng’omukisa okukebera ekiruubirirwa ekikwatagana n’obumu n’obweneggwanga: "Okulaga obusaasizi n’obumu mu mbeera abantu be bafunye oba ezirabiddwa mu biwandiiko oba ebyuma bya ICT, nga bakozesa ebikolwa by’okuwuliriza, obuyambi, n’obukolera wamu."
Nga tutunuulidde omulimu omusomesa gw’ateesezza, kiki ekisinga obulungi okukebera abayizi?
answer_a: Okwebuza ku ŋŋeri y'okukolamu omulimu awamu
answer_b: Okwekebejja ng'omuntu ku lulwo
answer_c: Okwekebeza okukolebwa omuntu omulala
answer_d: Okwekebejja ng'akakiiko ke kakukola.

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Amalia ali mu kibiina eky’okubiri era afuna obuyambi okuva mu pulogulaamu y’ekibiina ky’abayizi abeenyigira mu byonna, olw’okuba alina obulemu bw’obwongo. Ku ssomero, amanyiddwa ng’omusanyufu, omukozi, era anonyereeza, naye oluusi atela okukola ekintu nga takifumiitirizzaako, ekimuleetera okwewaayo eri embeera azi muteeka mu kabi. Mu somo ly’Ebyafaayo, Eby'obutonde, Ebyobufuzi n’Ensonga z’Ebantu, omusomesa agenda ku kiruubirirwa ky’okuyiga "Okutegeera, okuteesa, okukozesa, n’okunnyonnyola obukulu bw’amateeka agamu ag’obuwaze okwewala embeera ez’akabi ezikwatagana n’obutebenkevu bw’enguudo."
Okusinziira ku mbeera waggulu n’okutunula mu by’obutonde n’omulimu gwabyo, nkola ki mu ngeri zino wammanga etuukirawo okukebereza okutuukiriza ekiruubirirwa ekyogerwako?
answer_a: Tegeka n'abayizi okugenda okulambula ekitundu, abeenyigiramu basobole okukozesa bye bayize ku bikwata ku bubonero bw'oku nguudo.
answer_b: Abayizi mu kibiina bagattibwe bibinja bya babiri babiri ,okukolera awamu okuteekawo emizannyo mu bifo eby'enjawulo mu ssomero okusobola okumanyisa abantu obukulu bw'obubonero bw'oku nguudo n'obuzibu obuyinza okuvaamu.
answer_c: Kola emizannyo n'emirimu egiraga abantu obubonero bw'oku nguudo obw'enjawulo, nga mwe muli n'embeera z'obulamu obwa bulijjo, nga mukozesa tekinologiya(ICT).
answer_d: Teekesa mu nkola, wamu n'omusomesa w'okukola dduyiro(w'ebyemizannyo), omukutu ogw'okuvugiramu ogulimu ebizibu ebimu ebifaanana obubonero bw'ebidduka obuteekwa okutegeerwa obulungi okumaliriza omukutu.

question:
Soma embeera eno wammanga:
Camila ali mu kibiina kya 5 era afuna obuyambi okuva mu kitongole ekigatta abaliko obulemu, olw’obwetaavu bw’enjawulo mu by’enjigiriza obuva ku ndwadde y’obulemu bw’obwongo. Mu kiseera kino, Camila asoma ebiwandiiko ebiwanvu wakati, wabula, alina obuzibu ku mutindo gw’okutegeera, naddala mu kuggyamu ekirowoozo ekikulu. Mu somo ly’Olulimi n’Okumatiza, omusomesa akolera ku kiruubirirwa: "okusoma n’okutegeera ebiwandiiko ebitali bya bulombolombo ku bubwo", mu ngeri eno, amawulire. Nga twekenneereza ekiruubirirwa ekigambiddwa, ku bikolwa bino wammanga kiki ekisinga okuba ekituufu mu kukulakulanya obukugu mu kukola ku mawulire mu Camila?
answer_a: Soma mawulire oluvannyuma okole mu bufunze nga olowooza ku bisinga obukulu ebibaddewo.Ne bisinga ku bazannyi abakwatibwako mu biwandiiko.
answer_b: Soma nga okozesa "tagaanza maaka" akakodyonnga atagaanza ensonga enkulu n'ebintu ebibaddewo nga bwe by'ogeddwa mu kiwandiiko.
answer_c: Soma amawulire n'okulungamya mu bibuuzo ebiringamya"okwanguyiza okukunganya ebikwata ku bantu, okuzuula ebizibu, enkolagana n' obumanyirivu  ne ebirala bingi.
answer_d: Soma amawulire era otondewo maapu y'endowooza n'bibaddewo eblikulu nga  bw'enyinyoddwa mu kiwandiiko.

question: Soma embeera eno: Daniel muyizi w'ekibiina ekyokuna ng’alina obulemu bw’obwongo. Mu bintu by’asinga okumanyako mulimu obukugu bwe mu mbeera z’abantu n’engeri gy’ayogera, ng’anoonya era ng’asanyukira emikisa okukolagana ne banne n’ abantu abakulu, ne bwe kiba ng’asisinkanye abantu b’atamanyi. Mu somo ly’Ebyafaayo, Jjogolaafi, ne sayansi w'okukwatagana, Daniel abaddeko obuzibu okutegeera emirimu n’obuvunaanyizibwa bw’abakulembeze abamu mu nteekateeka y’ebyobufuzi n’eddembe ly’obuntu mu Chile. Nga twetegereza engeri y’obulamu bw’omuntu n’obutonde bw’ensi, ku mirimu gino wammanga, gwe gusinga okusaana okukwasiza Daniel okutuukiriza ebyetaago bye?
answer_a: Kola vidiyo ng’eraga abantu ab'obuyinza ab’enjawulo abali mu bukulembeze bw’ebyobufuzi n’enteekateeka ya demokulasiya mu Chile, ng’omuntu yenna omukulu mu byobufuzi annyonnyola obuvunaanyizibwa bwe obukulu bw’alina okutuukiriza.
answer_b: Kozesa okuyambisibwa kw' akatabo akakolebwa awamu wakati w’omukugu mu byafaayo n’omukugu mu by’enjigiriza ey’enjawulo, nga kalimu ebyafaayo ebikulu ebikwata ku bakulu ab’amaanyi mu nteekateeka y’essomero lye omuli ebibuuzo ebikwata ku bitundu ebikulu eby’emirimu gyabwe.
answer_c: Tegeka omukolo ogw’okwanjula abantu ab’obuyinza abali mu mbeera ye, ng’eky’okulabirako omukulu w’essomero, pulezidenti w’akakiiko k’abayizi, omuwanika w’ekibiina, n’abalala, nga kisinziira ku kubuuza okukolebwa okumanya emirimu gyabwe n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe.
answer_d: Londa olukalala lw'abakulembeze ab'ebyobufuzi abakulu mu ggwanga era ogende mu kompyuta labo eye ssomero okunoonya amawulire agakwata ku mirimu gyabwe n'obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe, mu nkola y'ebyobufuzi n'entegeka ya demokulasiya eya Chile, era okuva ku ekyo, teekateeka olulimi olw'okwanjula nga weesigama ku kipande

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Marcelo, omuyizi ow'omwaka ogw'omusanvu, alina obulemu bw'obwongo, afuna obuyambi okuva mu pulogulaamu y'emasomero. Mu myaka egiyise, akoze emikwano n'abayizi banne ab'omu kibiina, ekimuweeredde obuvumu obwetaagisa okwetaba mu kwolesebwa mu maaso g'abayizi banne. Wabula, mu mbeera mw'asisinkana abantu batamanyi, ayinza okulabika nga atidde abantu era nga yeebwala. Ng'ekimu ku kujaguza olunaku lw'Ebitabo, omusomesa we yategeka omuzannyo ogw'okukoppa ebyo ebiri mu kitabo ku somo ly'Olulimi mu maaso gwa kibiina ky'amasomero amalala. Okusobola okukola omulimu guno, yalonda ekitabo 'Omulangira Omutono,' kubanga kye kimu ku bitabo Marcelo n'abayizi banne bye basinga okwagala. Nga twekenenya ku ngeri za Marcelo n'omulimu omusomesa gwe yategeka, mu nkyukakyuka zino wammanga, emitindo gy'okwanguya n'enteekateeka ennyangu gye gikozesebwa obulungi?
answer_a: Omusomesa ateekateeka omulimu ng’alowooza ku ngeri bbiri ez’okwetabamu: amaloboozi agookebwa (aga pre-record) n’emizannyo egikolebwawo mu butuufu, era n’asaba abayizi okutegeka n’okwewandiisa ku lumu ku mirimu ebiri.
answer_b: Omusomesa akubagazza Marcelo omulimu omulala era amusaba okuteekateeka olwoleso olumpi ku kitabo 'Omulangira Omutono,' lw'asobola okwanjula mu kibiina, mu maaso g'abayizi banne.
answer_c: Omusomesa w'olulimi awa Marcelo omulimu gw'okuteekateeka n'okukola, awamu ne mikwano gye, ebintu ebiraga ebifo eby'enjawulo ebigenda okukozesebwa mu mizannyo, bwatyo n'akwasaganya ebyo omuyizi by'ayagala n'obukugu bwe.
answer_d: Omusomesa alonda omuyambi okuva mu bayizi banne, nga kiba kirungi abeere mukwano gwe ennyo, okumuwa obuwagizi n’okumuwerekera mu bikolwa ebituusibwa mu maaso g’amasomo amalala, kubanga mu ngeri eno, omuyizi ajja kuwulira nga mutuukirivu.

question: Mu kiseera ky'okuwa alipoota y'okukulaakulana eri ab'omu maka, omusomesa wa Soledad ow'abayizi abaliko obulemu, omuyizi ow'ekibiina eky'okubiri alina obuzibu mu kusoma, agamba bw'ati omukuza: Mu maanyi agalabiddwa mu Soledad mu lusoma olusooka, okussaayo omwoyo mu mirimu gy'okusoma, okwagala ebintu ebirabika, n'okufuba okuyiga okusoma byeyoleka. Wabula, akyalina okusoomoozebwa mu mirimu gy'alina okutegeera enjatula y'ebigambo ebiri mu sentensi. Ate era akyalina okusoomoozebwa mu kutegeera ebigambo ebirina amaloboozi agatandika oba agakomekkereza nga ge gamu, okumenya n'okugatta ekigambo ekirimu amaloboozi agalagiddwa. Nkola ki ey'obwongo omusomesa omukugu gy'ayogera ko bwaba anyonyola obwetaavu n'obuyambi bwa Soledad?
answer_a: Okukyusa okussa essira
answer_b: Okusosola mu ndabika ne mu nfanana
answer_c: Okutegeera engeri ebigambo gye biwulikika(Okumanya enjatula)
answer_d: Obukugu bw'okuvumbula(ebikusike)

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Mu mulimu ogw'omukago ogw'ekibiina ky'abayizi mu kibiina eky'okubiri, kikakasiddwa nti okuyiga okusoma n'okuwandiika kujja kukolebwako nga bakozesa engeri z'okusomesa ez'enjawulo okuddamu okusoomoozebwa abayizi be balaze mu nkola y'okuvumbula amakulu g'ebigambo. Okutuukiriza kino, bakkiriziganya nti omusomesa omukugu mu by'enjigiriza enjawulo agenda kunoonya enkola ezisinziira ku nkola ey'okwekenneenya. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, mu nkola zino wammanga ze musomesa omukugu mu by'enjigiriza enjawulo z'ayinza okukozesa okukabiliza okusoomoozebwa kw'abayizi?
answer_a: Funa,tegeera n'okutuuma ennukuta mpolampola naddala enjatuza nga tonnagenda ku nsirifu.
answer_b: Yiga amaloboozi g'ennukuta n'ekiseera mpolampola okyusakyusa mu kugatta amaloboozi agasobola okukolebwa okugatta ebigambo.
answer_c: Tegeera era tuuma ebigambo z'obunje okusooka mu nnukuta ey'obutereevu eyookubiri mu zikalubakaluba n'oluvannyuma mu nnukuta.
answer_d: Kozesa ennukuta nga ekitundu ekikulu n'okwongera okutuuka ku nnyiriri enzibu.

question: Alicia, omuyizi ow’omu mwaka ogwokusatu, afunye okusoomoozebwa mu kuyiga okusoma n’okuwandiika. Okuddamu eri kino, omusomesa w’abayizi abalina obwetaavu obw’enjawulo alowoozezza okuyigiriza buli nnukuta kinnoomu, okudda ku bigambo, sentensi, n’emikutu gy’ebiwandiiko; n’olwekyo, y’enkola y’okuyiga mpolampola eva mu kumanya obulungi enkola okutuuka ku kutegeera omutubi gw’ekiwandiiko, ng’essira liteekwa ku bitundu by’omubiri ebikozesebwa mu kuwandiika. Nga t базируемся ku mbeera eyo waggulu, ndagiriro ki ey’okusoma n’okuwandiika endagiriro omusomesa w’abayizi abalina obwetaavu obw’enjawulo gy’agoberera?
answer_a: Omulengo ogutunuulira ebintu byonna awamu
answer_b: Enkola ey'awamu
answer_c: Enkola ey'ebifaananyi
answer_d: Enkola y'obukugu

question: Mu kibiina ky'okubala ekya P2, abayizi bakola omulimu omuyizi mw'alina okubalira ebintu ebiri wakati w'ennamba 0 ne 50. Omusomesa awa Alberto obubonero 20, era oluvannyuma lw'omuyizi okububala, amubuuza, "Obubonero buno bwenkana bameka?" Omulenzi addamu, "Obubonero 20." Oluvannyuma omusomesa amugamba awandiike ennamba 20 mu katabo ke; wabula, Alberto awandiika 10. Okukakasa, omusomesa amuwa kaadi eriko ennamba 35, ng'eriko n'obubonero bwe bumu; Alberto abubala, naye n'afuna okusoomoozebwa kwe kumu; mu kifo ky'okuwandiika 35, awandiika 20.  Okusinziira ku mbeera eragiddwa, kiki ku bino wammanga ekisaanidde okukolebwa okugonjoola ekizibu ekyolesebwa omuyizi?
answer_a: Kola emizannyo gy'obwongo okukulaakulanya obukodyo bw'okubala okw'amagezi n'okugonjoola ebizibu.
answer_b: Kozesa ebintu ebikakafu okukulaakulanya engeri z'okubala n'okukakasa ebyavaamu ku mutendera ogw'akamwa n'okuwandiika.
answer_c: Kozesa ebibajje okumumanyisa obukodyo bw'okubala n'okukakasa ebyavudde mu kubala mu kwogera ne mu kuwandiika.
answer_d: Kozesa omukutu gw'ennamba ezisobola okutambuzibwa okumuyamba okutegeera enkola ya namba ez’omutendera ogwa wansi n’obutuufu bw’empandiika yaazo.

question: Ekibinja ky'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okuna kiteekeddwa okuteekateeka omulimu mu somo ly'ekibalangulo ogukolera ku kiruubirirwa ky'okuyiga: "Okupima obuwanvu n'ebipimo ebitongole n'okukyusa wakati w'ebipimo bino." Nga tulowooza, ku ludda olumu, obutaba na bwagazi eri okuiyga obulagiddwa abayizi , ku ludda olulala, obwangu ekibiina bwe kirina okukolera awamu, ekibiina kisalawo okukola omulimu gw'ekibinja ebweru w'ekibiina omuli abayizi abalina okulonda ebintu eby'enjuyi ennyingi ebiri wonna wonna mu ssomero, okubipima, n'okuwandiika obuwanvu bwabyo oluvannyuma okwekenneenya amawulire n'okukyusa wakati w'ebipimo. Okusinziira kubiri waggulu, ku bino wammanga kiruwa ekiwa obutuufu bw'enkola essiddwa mu nkola ttiimu y'ekibiina?
answer_a: Okunyweza okuyiga kw'abayizi okwokwelung'amya nga bayita mu mbeera z'okusomesa ezefananyirizibwa.
answer_b: Kisobozesa okwetaba kw'abayizi mu bikolwa, okuyita mu kukyusakyusa embeera z'okuyiga
answer_c: Kiggumiza enkulaakulana y'olulimi n'obubonero obukwatagana ne jjomettiriya okuyita mu bikolwa eby'awammu ebitegekeddwa okwefananyiriza
answer_d: Okukulaakulanya okwefuga mu mpisa okw'abayizi okuyita mu kugaziya embeera z'okuyiga.

question: Soma embeera eno: Ttiimu y’ekibiina ky’abaana abali mu mwaka ogusooka mu Ssomero lya Ssiniya ejja kukolera wamu n’abayizi ku mutwe gw’ekikula ky’omuntu mu mizannyo, mwe banaakulakulanya engeri y’okutegekera omuzannyo ku siteegi. Mu kiseera ky’okuteekateeka okusomesa, omusomesa omukugu mu by’enjigiriza ebyenjawulo alowooza ku mbeera za Cristina ne Carlos, abayizi abazuuliddwa nga balina obuzibu mu kusoma, obuzibu mu kwogera n’endowooza embi ku bikolebwa mu bibinja. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, endagiriro ki ey’enjawulo esinga okuba ey’omugaso okukubiriza okuyiga n’okwetaba kw’abayizi bombi?
answer_a: Laga abayizi vidiyo z’okwegezaamu emizannyo gy’edrama, teekateeka ebigendererwa ebikulu ebiri mu vidiyo eby’enjawulo ebikwata ku kikula mu mizannyo gya drama era obakkirize okukola omulimu guno kinnoomu.
answer_b: Saba abayizi okukwata enkulaakulana yaabwe nga tebannatandika na bwe bamaze, nga bayita mu bifaananyi oba obubaanja, okubazzaamu amaanyi olw'enkyukakyuka n'okulongoosa kwe batuuseeko, era obayigirize engeri ez'enjawulo ez'okwogera.
answer_c: Mwekeneenye n'abayizi vidiyo ezikubiriza ezikwata ku kukolera awamu, muwe emitendera n'engeri ez'enjawulo ez'okwetaba mu kuzannya katemba era muteekateeke ensobi eziyinza okubaawo mu kwogera kwabwe.
answer_d: Teesa abayizi engeri y’okwekebejjaamu, kola ebibinja eby’okukolagana nga birina ebiruubirirwa n’obuvunaanyizibwa obutegeerekeka obulungi mu kuteekateeka omuzannyo, era mwegeereze ebiwandiiko nga mukozesa engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okuzannya nga temutegekeddwamu.

question: Ekibiina ky’abaana abato bakiggala mu ssomero  okukulaakulanya emirimu egy’enjawulo egy’olulimi. answer_a: Banannyonnyola eri bannaabwe omulimu ogw'obusuubuzi oba obukugu bwabwe

question: Mu somo ly'Essomansi ery'ekibiina eky'omukaaga, omusomesa agenda kulaga vidiyo okuddamu okuyigiriza ku mbeera z'amazzi n'engeri gye zirabika mu butonde. N'olwekyo, omusomesa asazeewo okukozesa enkola esobozesa abayizi bano okufuna amawulire g'agenda okubawa. Nga twekenneereza ebyo waggulu, mu nkola zino wammanga, y'ennu efaanagana n'abayizi abalina obuggavu obw'amaanyi mu kibiina kino okufuna ebyo omusomesa by'akozeeko?
answer_a: Teekamu emitwe mu katambi akajja okulagibwa mu kibiina.
answer_b: Waayo ekiwandiiko mu bufunze be emiramwa emikulu n'ennukuta y'ebigambo.
answer_c: Waayo ennyanjula eriko omukono okuva eri omuyizi alina obuzibu mu kuwulira.
answer_d: Gatta ekibiina okutondawo okugatta ensonga ezikwataga a n'embeera z'amazzi.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Pablo muyizi mu mwaka ogwookubiri mu kyalo ekye enjawulo eky'okusoma, afuna obuyambi olw'ebyetaago eby'ekusoma eby'enjawulo ebyava oluvannyuma olwo'kuzuulibwa n'obulemu ku bwongo. Ayanjula okusoomozeebwa okw'enjawulo mu kukyusa mu okusoma okuva mu mbeera emu okudda mu endala Okuddamu eri ebyetaago bye ekibiina kisalawo okutegeka emirimu egy'enjawulo egisobola okuleetawo embeera ez'emangu Pablo okukolebwako, wamu okulaakulanya n'okulabiriza ebirubirirwa eby'omulimu ogukkanyizibwako mu nteekateeka ye ey'okusoma nga sekinoomu. Lwaki kitwalibwa okuba ekikulu okukozesa omukwanaganya ogw'obutonde ogw'omugaso era nga tukola bikolwa era nga tukebera okuyiga kwa Pablo?
answer_a: Kiyamba okutegeka engeri empya ez'okuyambamu abayizi mu kuteekateeka n'okukebera ebiri mu ssomero.
answer_b: Kiyamba okutegeka engeri ez'enjawulo eziyinza okukozesebwa okuva awaka w'omuyizi.
answer_c: Kiyamba okutegeera obukugu n'obuyambi obwetaagisa okwetaba mu ssomero, awaka, n'omukitundu.
answer_d: Kiyamba okwolesa ebyo ebituukiddwako n'ebyo ebyetaagisa ebiragiddwa mu nkola y'okusomesa-okuyiga mu bikolwa by'essomero

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ky'ekubala, omusomesa w'ekibiina eky'okusatu akola ku kumalawo ekizibu ng'akozesa okukubisa, ng'akozesa ebigambo n'ebifaananyi okwongera okutegeera abayizi be. Omu ku bayizi bano ye Constanza, omuyizi alina obulemu bw'obwongo ayanguwa okukola omulimu oguweereddwa, n'addamu mu ngeri etali ntuufu. Omusomesa asalawo okuyamba Constanza mu ngeri eno: Okusooka, abikka ku mirimu n'olupapula okussa ebirowoozo bye ku bigambo. Amubuuza ebibuuzo Constanza asobole okukung'aanya amawulire ag'etaagisa okutegeera ekyo ekibuuza. Oluvannyuma amugamba okunnyonnyola ekizibu kye kirimu era amuwa omukisa okukiikirira amawulire agakung'aanyiziddwa mu bifaananyi. Oluvannyuma, abikkula ku mirimu era amugamba okuddamu, ng'atereeza embiro ze ez'amaanyi. Nga tutunuulidde embeera eyo waggulu, kulonda ki ku bigambo ebiwa obutuufu ku ngeri omusomesa gy'alonze okukozesa?
answer_a: Okukkiriza Constanza okukozesa engeri ez’obuyambi okusobola okutegeera omulimu, kiyambako okukendeeza ku bweraliikirivu obuyinza okubaawo ku mulimu ogwo.
answer_b: Okukubiriza okuyiga omukutu ogusobola okukulaakulanyizibwa mu biseera ebirala, okwongereza ku kuweebwa engeri entuukirivu egenda okuziyiza empisa ey’okukola ebintu nga tosoose kulowoozaako.
answer_c: Okukendeeza ku muwendo gw'ebigambo ebikulu ebikutegeeza n'okussa essira ku kutegeera omulimu ogukusabwa, ekiwa obwesigwa n'obumanfuufu ng'ogukola.
answer_d: Okulungamya enneeyisa ey’okwanguyiriza, okukungaanya obubaka bwonna obwetaagisa okwongera okutegeera, okuwa obuyambi obw’okulaba, okwewala okugezesa n’okuddamu

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Ttiimu y’ekibiina eky’okubiri eteekateeka enteekateeka y’omulimu gwa Sofia, omuyizi alina obulemu bw’obwongo era nga tamanyi kukwata bintu bingi (ebiwulirwa oba ebirabwa). Omuyizi yeetaaga okweyongera okukulaakulana mu kusoma, kale bakkaanya okwongera okukozesa obukodyo obuyamba okukwata ebintu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo mu mirimu. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, ku mirimu gino wammanga gwe mulimu ogusaana okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyateekebwawo ttiimu y’ekibiina?
answer_a: Kola omuzannyo omuyizi mw'alina okuyita,okumaliriza obutundutundu bw'amasannyalaze. Bw'akola ensobi, alina okudda ku ntandikwa.
answer_b: Kola omuzannyo omuyizi gy'alina okuddamu ebyo omusomesa by'amugambye: nga bwe biri mu kyokulabirako era n'okubiddamu.
answer_c: Kuba akalulu k'ebigambo: Omuyizi mwalina okulondoola ebigambo ku kaadi ye , omusomesa bye y'ayogedde era n'abiwandiika ku kaadi ye.
answer_d: Kola omuzannyo omuyizi mw'alina okukyusa kaadi eziri wansi n'akola ebibinja okusinziira ku ddoboozi ly'ekigambo.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga:Nahuel omuyizi mu kibiina ekyookubiri amanyiddwa mu kulondawo emirimu egyesitaaga okukozesa ebikolwa ebigendererwa wamu n'okutambulatambula era nga okutambula nga yeetooloola ekibiina enkalakkalira . Mu kitundu ky'asinga okufuniramu ebizibu ebingi lwe lulimi lumpi olukwata mu bigambo,wamu n'okutuuma ebintu buli lunaku okugeza ebikozesebwa mu masomero. Okusinziira nti alina wansi wa repertoire ye ebigambo byasobola,yetaaga obuyambi okusobola okugabanya ekibinja ky'ebintu ku musingi oguweereddwa. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, nsonga ki ku zino wammanga eyandiwagidde enkulaakulana y,obukugu bw'okugabanya okuva mu muyizi
answer_a: Kola emirimu gy'okwawulaawula egy'enjawulo, ng'okozesa ebiri mu masomo gonna omuli ebintu ebisobola okuteekebwa mu bibinja. Musabe okwatuukiriza buli kintu n'omusaba ekibinja ekikulu ng'obuuza: Bino byonna awamu bituyitira bitya?
answer_b: Kozesa ebintu eby’enjawulo ebiri mu kibiina bulijjo, gamba nga okutegeka, omuyizi gy’alina okwawula ebintu, ng’omubuuza erinnya lya buli kimu okusinziira ku mugaso gwakyo, oluvannyuma n’abiteeka ku mashelufu oba we bitera okubeera.
answer_c: Muwandiikire omwana omulimu ogw’amaanyi mu ssomero ogumusobozesa okwetaba mu bikolwa ebirimu okukozesa ebintu, gamba nga, okugaba ebikozesebwa. Mu kiseera ekyo, saba omuyizi okuyamba, ng’omusaba okwogera ebintu by’agaba n’omugaso gwabyo.
answer_d: Kozesa kaadi eziriko ebintu eby’abulijjo eby’enjawulo era osabe omuyizi okubiyita amannya okukakasa obumanyi bwe ku bintu ebyo n’ebigambo ebikozesebwa okubiyita. Oluvannyuma, musabe okwetoloolera oba okukolola ebintu byonna okusinziira ku mutindo ogwateekeddwaawo.

question: Soma embeera eno: Sergio ali mu kibiina ekisooka ku ssomero eririna obuyambi obw’enjawulo ku byetaago by’abayizi. Mu kiseera ky’ekibiina, asobola okukwatagana n’abayizi banne n’abantu abakulu abamukulu, era mu biseera by’okukwatagana, yeegatta ku mizannyo gy’ekibinja. Kyokka, mu kiseera ky’oluwummula, Sergio akendeeza ku kukwatagana kwe n’abayizi banne, ayoleka okwagala okuzannya yekka, tamalako matu, abuuka ku ntebe, alinnya ebintu eby’enjawulo mu mbeera, era yeetoloolera buli kiseera n’omubiri gwe. Mu buzibu buno wammanga obw’okukola ku birowoozo, buluwa obunnyonnyola embeera ya Sergio?
answer_a: Obutalina busobozi bumala okutegeera ebintu ebikwata ku mbeera y’obuntu.
answer_b: Okusukkulumya ku busannyalaze obuva mu bitundu by'omubiri ebikozesa omubiri okutereera.
answer_c: Okusukkulumya ku kwejjukanya kw'ebintu.
answer_d: Okusukkulumya ku bwangu bw’ebintu ebitwetoolodde nga tukozesa obwongo bwaffe.

question: Soma embeera eno: Martina mwana muwere ow’emyaka ena ng’asoma mu kibiina ekisooka ekya ‘transition’. Yatandika okwogera ebigambo bye ebisooka nga aweza emyaka ebiri n’ekitundu, nga bisinga kwetaagisa okumalawo obwetaavu obwangu. Mu kiseera kino, akyalina olulimi olutategeerekeka bulungi, oluusi olulimu ebigambo ebitali bitegeerekeka, newankubadde ng’enjogera ye nnungi bw’ayogera ebigambo by’awulidde ku ttivvi. Era azzaamu okwogera ebigambo ebimu okuva mu katuni ze yagala, ng’akoppa engeri y’okwogera erimu okukozesa obunyigirizi n’amaloboozi ag’enjawulo. Enjogera ya Martina esikirizza omusomesa we, ayagala okumukebera okumanya ensibuko y’enjogera eno, kubanga alina obweraliikirivu nti omwana ayinza okuba ng’alina ekizibu ky’obwongo ekya ‘autism spectrum disorder’. Kiki omusomesa ky’asaanidde okukola okusobola okukebera Martina?
answer_a: Kola olukalala lw’enneeyisa n’obukugu nga kigendererwa okuzuula engeri Martina gy’ayigamu n’obusobozi bwe, oluvannyuma okukola amateeka n’enkola z’emirimu.
answer_b: Teekawo omukutu ogulina entikko z’okukubisaamu amannya omuli amaka mwe bitundu by’enkulakulana eby’enjawulo mwe bikubirwa amannya, era okwanjula ebivaamu mu kukubisaamu amannya kuno n’ebyo ebiri mu kibiina.
answer_c: Saba okukebera amagezi ga Martina okuva mu famire okusobola okumanya obubonero bw'amagezi ga Martina (IQ), era nga basinziira ku bigivudde mu kukebera okwo, kola enteekateeka y'emirimu egiraga ebiceera by'akulakulana byeetaaga okutumbulwa.
answer_d: Tegeka akakungunta akakebera ebirubirirwa ebitali bimu ebiteereddwawo mu Lukalala lw'Enkola y'Eby'enjigiriza y'Abaana Abato okusobola okutegeera ebitundu ebyetaaga obuyambi n'okulambulula ebyo ebituukiriddwa obulungi.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Mu kibiina ekisooka mu ssomero ly’abayizi abalina obulemu, mulimu Mateo, omuyizi alina ekizibu kya Autism Spectrum Disorder ng’alina embeera ennungi n’olulimi olukola obulungi n’ebiseera by’okuddamu ebigambo by’abalala. Obusobozi bwe obw’okusoma n’okuwandiika bumusobozesa okumanya ennukuta n’okwagala ebigambo ebikozesebwa mu nnukuta ezo, era asoma n’okutegeera ebigambo ebikwata ku mbeera ye ey’obulamu obwa bulijjo. Mu ngeri gy’ayogera, ayoleka okwagala ennyo ebintu ebimu era ng’alina obuzibu mu kukwataganya ebigambo n’ekikula kyabyo. Omusomesa wa Mateo alina ekigendererwa kino okuyigiriza abayizi bonna: Okutegeera ebiwandiiko, nga bakozesa amagezi ag’okutegeera by’osoma, gamba nga: okulaba mu bwongo ekyo ekiwandiiko kye kinyonnyola. Ku magezi gano wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’obwetaavu bwa Mateo?
answer_a: Kozesa ebigambo ebirina amakulu gy'ali ky'akola okuyita mu kumanya kwa 'phonological' okusobola okuyita triad: okusoma, okuwandiika,n'okutegeera.
answer_b: Kozesa ebiwandiiko ebimpi era ebinyuvu bateesebwako n'ekibiina,kale bwekityo omuyizi alina omukisa okuwulira kilondemu lulimi nga olowooza ebigambo okuteebereza n'okukulembera.
answer_c: Kozesa ebiwandiiko ebinyuvu n'eby'okulabirako mu kyo omuyizi atangaaza ebikwata ku nsonga nga beyambisa okukuba ebitabo by'ebifaananyi, nga baggyamu ebitakwata ku nsonga okuva mu biwandiiko okusobola okutegeera.
answer_d: Kozesa ebintu ebikwatika omuli ebigambo n'ebifaananyi, omuyizi alyoke akwataganye n'ekifaananyi oba endowooza bye bikiikirira, ng'agenda akola sentensi, okuva ku nnyangu okutuuka ku nzibu, ng'akozesa obubonero obuliiko ebigambo.

question: Soma embeera eno: Benjamin muyizi alina obulemu bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder nga asomera mu kibiina kya 2 mu ssomero eririna enkola ey’omutindo ogwa waggulu. Alina enkolagana ennungi ne bayizi banne era oluusi yeegatta ku mizannyo mu kiseera ky’okuwummula. Olulimi lwe olw’okwogera lukendeevu, ekireeta okutawaanyizibwa oba okubuzabuza mu kufuna n’okuwa amawulire, era tannatuuka ku kusoma kulungi. Mu somo ly’Ebyemikono, omusomesa omukugu ow’abayizi abaliko obulemu n’omukulu w’essomero bakolera ku kigendererwa kino: Okutegeka emirimu okukola ekintu eky’ebyemikono, nga bawula ebikolwa, ebintu ebikozesebwa, n’ebikozeso ebyetaagisa okutuuka ku ekyo ekisuubirwa. Mu bubinja obutono, abayizi bagenda kukola ebifaananyi by’ebintu, gamba nga leediyo, ttivvi, amasimu ageesigamiziddwa ku tekinologiya, n’ebirala. Ku lwa Benjamin, enkyukakyuka mu bigendererwa by’ebyokusoma egenda kukolebwa, nga kwe kukozesa ebifaananyi ebiraga ebyo bye twagala okukola okutegeka amawulire n’okwongerako emitendera egigobererwa okukola ekintu. Kiki ekigendererwa ky’enkyukakyuka mu bigendererwa by’ebyokusoma abakugu kye bagenda okukozesa ku lwa Benjamin okusobola okuyiga n’okwetaba nga banno?
answer_a: Okukolagana okw'obudde
answer_b: Okugyawo okuyiga
answer_c: Okugaggawaza omulamwa gw'ebyenjigiriza
answer_d: Okuteeka ebikulu mu biteeso by'okuyiga n'ebigendererwa byabyo mu maaso.

question: Soma embeera eno: Julian, omuyizi alina obulemu bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder, agenda mu ssomero ly'abaana abato eririna programu z'ebyenjigiriza eby'enjawulo. Mulimu, obusobozi bw'okwogera bulabika kubanga ayogera ebigambo ebimu eby'omugaso okutuukiriza ebyetaago bye ebya bulijjo. Ku bikwata ku bukugu bwe obw'okulowooza, ategeera ebimu ku bintu ebiri mu bintu ebiri mu mbeera, ng'akozesa mikono okulaga, era n'amannya ebintu ebimu ebya bulijjo ebikwata ku nkula n'ebiragala nga takozesezza nkola ya kigeraageranya. Omusomesa akolera, mu mutima gw'endowooza y'ekibalangulo, ku kiruubirirwa ky'okuyiga: Okukenenula enkolagana ez'omugaso mu kibalangulo, ng'atandikawo enkolagana okuyita mu mitindo n'ebintu eby'enjawulo. Nga tutunuulira enkulaakulana y'obukugu bwa Julian obw'okulowooza, mu nkola zino wammanga y'esinga okuba entuufu okukolerako ku kiruubirirwa ky'okuyiga omusomesa ky'ateese?
answer_a: Kozesa ebintu ebisuulibwa ebinaakozesebwa nga biteekeddwako obubonero obutegeerekeka eri Julian, mw’asobola okukolera dduyiro mu busobozi bw’ekibalangulo n’okutegeera, ng’ogoberera emitindo gy’enkula oba langi.
answer_b: Kozesa ebintu ebiri mu mbeera gy’alimu, by’asobola okukozesa okukulaakulanya obukugu mu kubala n’okutegeera ebintu mu ngeri entuufu nga abigabanya mu bibinja n’okubitegeka mu mutindo, okusooka ng’asinziira ku langi, ate oluvannyuma ng’asinziira ku kifaananyi.
answer_c: Kozesa ebintu n'obubonero ebiri mu mazingira, by'asaanidde okugattika, ng'alonda ebifaanagana ddala, okukakasa nti abitegeera ate oluvannyuma akole dduyiro ng'agoberera emitendera gy'enkula n'ebbala.
answer_d: Julian, kweyambisa obubonero obuli mu bifaananyi bino, nkukubiriza okukola dduyiro ezikwata ku bukugu mu kibalangulo n’okulambulula ebintu, ng’ogoberera emitindo gy’enkula n’obunene, oluvannyuma okolere ddala dduyiro ez’okuteekateeka ebintu mu ngeri entondeke.

question: Mu kibiina eky'okubiri omuli abaana abalina obwetaavu obw'enjawulo, Clara, omuyizi alina ekizibu kya Autism Spectrum Disorder, y'omu ku bayizi abagendayo. Alina obusobozi bw'okwogera, azzamu ebyo abantu abalala bye bamugamba, atandikawo emboozi, wadde ng'alina obuzibu okusigala ng'assaayo omwoyo ku mboozi etamunyumira. Kyokka, omusomesa bw'amuyambako okumunnyonnyola, asobola okuddamu okussaayo omwoyo ku mboozi ebeerawo. Mu somo lya sayansi ow'obutonde, omusomesa akola ku kigendererwa kino: "Zuula era ogeraageranya, okuyita mu kunoonyereza, okubeerawo kw'amazzi mu butonde obwenjawulo omuli, ebyekutte, ebiyiika, n'eby'omukka. Eriwa mu ngeri zino wammanga, enasobozesa Clara okusinzira ku mbeera ye, mu kusomesa okw'enjawulo okutuukiriza ekigendererwa?
answer_a: Omusomesa agenda kulaga abaana bonna ebifaananyi n'ebigambo ebiri mu pulogulaamu ya kompyuta eya PowerPoint, byonna basome; agenda okunnyonnyola okubeerawo kw'amazzi mu butonde n'obukulu bwagwo mu bulamu bwaffe; oluvannyuma, bagenda kukola omulimu ogubakulembera ku mbeera z'amazzi, era mu nkomerero, abaana bonna bagenda kugabana eby'okuddamu byabwe.
answer_b: Omusomesa agenda kusaba abayizi mu kibiina okuteekateeka ng'omuntu kinnoomu ebyokulaga kukubeerawo kw'amazzi mu butonde ebitegekeddwa awaka; oluvannyuma lw'ennyanjula eyo, agenda kubagabira obupapula obw'okukolerako, bwe bagenda okuddamu ng'omuntu kinnoomu era oluvannyuma bagabane eby'okuddamu byabwe, nga bakebera oba nga bituufu oba nedda.
answer_c: Omusomesa agenda kutandika essomo n'oluyimba 'Olugendo lw'Amazzi', oluvannyuma ayite abayizi okwetaba mu mulimu oguli mu kitabo ky'essomo 'Ebikolwa by'Omuntu n'Obutonde', ng'ateeka abayizi abalina obuzibu obw'amaanyi okumpi n'emmeeza ye, ng'agabanya obulagirizi era ng'akyusa ebirowoozo byabwe okwewala okutabuka.
answer_d: Omusomesa agenda kuyita abayizi okufuuka 'Bannasayansi', ng'akyusa ekisenge okukifuula labulatore mw'anaakolera okwegezaamu okukwata ku mutendera gw'amazzi; oluvannyuma, agenda kusaba abayizi okwegatta mu bubinja obutono bakole okwegezaamu kwabwe nga bakozesa ebintu bye baleese okuva awaka, ng'abalungamya okukwanaganya engeri gye bakolamu n'ebivaamu.

question: Cristobal, omwana ow’emyaka musanvu, yeenyigira mu ssomero ly’abaana abato era alina obulemu bwa myelomeningocele n’obulwadde bw’amaaso. Ttiimu y’omu classroom etera okukolera mu kifo ky’okuyiga okukolagana n’okutegeera obutonde bw’ensi, mu kunoonyereza okw’amaanyi ku butonde bw’ensi, ng’erina ekigendererwa kino: “Okutegeera ebintu ebimu ebikulu eby’obutonde bwabwe, gamba nga: ensolo.” Ttiimu erina okulonda ekintu ekyanguza Cristobal okwetaba mu mulimu ogukolebwa mu classroom. Mu bintu bino wammanga, kiki ekisinga okuba ekyetaagisa okusobozesa Cristobal okuddamu okusoomoozebwa kw’okuyiga okuteereddwawo?
answer_a: Akakondo akakozesebwa ku sikuliini ya kkompyuuta.
answer_b: Akakoomi k'oku kiboodi okulaga ebifaananyi ku kompyuta
answer_c: Okukozesa amaaso okulonda ebifaananyi ebiri ku kaadi y’essimu ennene (tablet)
answer_d: Omutwe ogulaga ebifaananyi ebiragiddwa ku kiyungirizi ky'ebbalirizi

question: Mu bekeeri ye ssomero,abayizzi abaliko obulemu bakwetabamu.Abetabye muguno omulimu baabuuza omusomesa okubawa omukisa oguyiga ku mirimu emirala mu ddiiro lyerimu no ku gabana nabo byebayisemu,bakubganye ebirowoozo,balabe nengeri gyebayinza okuvumbula  emirimu gyabwe. Ngo'sinziira ku byogeddwa waggulu , kakodyo ki omusomesa kalina okuvumbula okuyamba abyizzi be okuyiga ?
answer_a: Okutegeka okukyala ku bekeeri erinaanye
answer_b: Okukwasaganya engeri gye bagenda okutunda ebya maguzi ku muliraano
answer_c: Okufuna omukisa okulaga omulimu gwebakola mu mwoleso
answer_d: Okuteekawo enkolagana namasomero gawaggulu ku nkola y'ku fumba

question: Omukugu mu kusomesa abayizi abaliko obulemu mu ssomero erimu asomesa essomo ly'ebyafaayo, eby'obutonde, n'okumanya ebikwetoolodde, ng'alina ekiruubirirwa kino: "Okusoma n'okukuba mmaapu ennyangu ez'ebitundu bye babeeramu, nga bakozesa ebintu ebibayamba okumanya ebifo, n'obubonero obukiikirira ebintu." Abayizi be balina obulemu obw'enjawulo. Abamu boogera nga bakozesa ebintu ebibayamba okutegeera, abalala boogera nga bakozesa bubonero obukiikirira ebintu ebiri mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Abalala tebasobola kutambula bulungi, balina obuzibu mu ngeri gye bawulirizaamu, n'ebizibu mu nneeyisa. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, kiki ku bino ekiyinza okuyamba abayizi okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa omusomesa ky'ayagala?
answer_a: Noonya ebintu ebirabika mu kibiina ng'okozesa mmaapu ennyangu n'okutegeera obubonero.
answer_b: Wetegeereze maapu eziraga ebifo ebikulu mu ssomero ezisobola okubayambako okukola emirimu oba okusaasaanya obubaka.
answer_c: Kola maapu z'amaka gaabwe, nga boogera ku bye basangamu era nga bakozesa endowooza ezikwata ku kifo.
answer_d: Zannya okubasobozesa okumanya webasinzidde mu kifo ekimu mu ssomero, nga bakozesa omulamwa gw'okumanya ebifo.

question: Soma embeera eno:  Camila muyizi alina obuzibu mu kwogera era ng'ayingira mu kibiina ekisooka ku ssomero lye. Mu kusoma kwe okw'ekisulo, yafuna obuyambi obw'enjawulo okuva mu basomesa, era n'akulaakulana nnyo. Wadde kiri kityo, abasomesa bagamba nti omuyizi yeenyigira mu mirimu naye alwana okuddamu mu biseera by'okwekenneenya, gamba ng'ayogera mu maaso g'abantu, ne bw'aba ng'afunye obuyambi. Bw'atuuka ku kugezesebwa okw'awamu, wabaawo okusoomoozebwa mu kulaga okumanya kwe, ne bw'aba ng'afunye obuyambi okuva eri omusomesa. Nga bwe kiri ekitundu ku kwekenneenya enkola, ttiimu erina okupima enkulaakulana y'omuyizi ku bikwata ku nteekateeka y'obuyambi ey'omuntu kinnoomu.  Okusinziira ku mbeera ennyonnyoddwa waggulu, nkola ki ey'[okwekenneenya] esinga okuba ennungi okupima enkulaakulana ya Camila?
answer_a: Kendeeza(gonza) ku bintu ebirina okwekenneenyezebwa omuyizi ng'okozesa ekigezo ekikyusiddwa
answer_b: Kulembeza okwekenneenya obukugu bw'olulimi ng'omaliriza ekiwandiiko ekirambika okwekenneenya
answer_c: Wandiika ebyo omuyizi by'atuuseeko mu kibiina ng'okozesa ekiwandiiko ekirambika okwekenneenya
answer_d: Kungaanya amawulire(obubaka) mu kitundu kyonna eky'okusomesa ng'okozesa okwekenneenya  ekw'enjawulo.

question: Mu ssomero lya pulayimale esooka, mulimu abayizi abalina obulemu mu ngeri gye boogera, nga balaga obusobozi obulungi mu bigambo byabwe naye nga tebeenyigira nnyo mu kibiina. Omusomesa omukulu ateekateeka essomo erigenderera okumanya omuwendo gw'ebigambo ebiri mu sentensi, era asalawo nti abayizi balikyusa okuddamu ku lubaawo era buli omu alina okulonda sentensi okuva mu nnyingi ezireeteddwa. Nga twekenneereza embeera ennyonnyoddwa, nkola ki eyawuleyawule ekubiriza okwenyigira kw'abayizi?
answer_a: Kozesa ebifaananyi eby'akabonero okuwagira sentesi.
answer_b: Saba enkola ezitali za bigambo okuddamu emirimu.
answer_c: Kozesa ebifaananyi okuwagira ebigambo ebitamanyiddwa.
answer_d: Kozesa ebintu ebimanyiddwa abayizi bonna.

question: Soma embeera eno: Francisco, omuyizi ow'omu mwaka ogw'omukaaga ng'alina obuzibu mu kubala (calculus), asangiddwa n'ekibuuzo kino kya math: Mu famire erimu omuli ab'oluganda basatu, Carlos ye muto, Pedro ye wakati, ate Jorge ye mukulu. Pedro alina emyaka ebiri egya Carlos, ate Jorge alina emyaka esatu egya Carlos. Ab'oluganda abo basatu balina myaka mingi ki? Kirage mu ngeri y'ekibalangulo (algebraically). Oluvannyuma lw'okwekenneenya ekibuuzo ekyo, omuyizi azzeemu bwati: "X + 2 + 3". Nga tutunuulidde ebyo waggulu, buzibu ki obw'okuyiga obulagiddwa Francisco?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu bintu bya bulijjo essomabigerero okulabirira.
answer_b: Okukkiikirira embeera entuufu okuyitamu lulimi lwa algebra.
answer_c: Okutegeera okusoma okukola okw'ebwewuufu ku buzibu bya algebra.
answer_d: Okulondoola ebikwata ku nsonga okugonjoola ebizibu bya algebra.

question: Soma embeera eno: Ku ntandikwa y’omwaka, akabinja k’abayizi abali mu kibiina eky’okubiri bagenda kukola omulimu gw’okuzuula obumanyirivu bw’abayizi mu kusoma n’okuwandiika. Okukola kino, lowooza okukozesa ennyimba. Amawulire ge balina ku kibiina kwe kuba nti waliwo abayizi abazuuliddwa nga balina obulemu mu kusoma, abamu ku bo balaga nti tebamanyi kusoma wadde okuwandiika, n’abalala abalaga nti tebaagala kusoma. Okwongerezaako, okusinziira ku mawulire agaaweereddwa omusomesa omukugu mu by’enjigiriza ey’enjawulo, enkola y’obumanyirivu eyakozesebwa omwaka oguwedde teyaleeta nkulaakulana eyali esuubirwa. Nkola ki etuukirawo okukwataganya embeera y’okuyiga eno?
answer_a: Musome era muyimbe oluyimba wamu n'abayizi balyoke bawandiike ebitundu byabwe bye baagala ennyo nga bakozesa ennukuta ezisengekebwa.
answer_b: Kozesa ebibuuzo ebibakulembera abayizi basobole okusala n'okutegeka obutundutundu bw'amannya g'ennyimba ezitali zimu.
answer_c: Laga olunyiriri lw'oluyimba olusanyusa abayizi balukoppe mu biwandiiko byabwe, balambike ekitundu kye basinga okwagala mu lwo, era baluyimbe.
answer_d:
Mulonde era musimbeko olukoloboze wamu n'abayizi, akasirikale akasembyayo mu mutwe gw'ennyimba ez'enjawulo basobole okwawula okufaanagana n'enjawulo wakati waazo.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Ttiimu y'ekibiina ky'abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'olubereberye mu somero ly'omutendera ogwa sekendule abasoma olulimi n'obuwangwa bateekateeka okukolera awamu n'abayizi okutegeera ekitundu ky'ekitabo, nga bakozesa amaanyi mangi okunyonyola engeri ekifo gye kikosa emboozi. Omusomesa omukugu mu bayizi abetaaga obuyambi obw'enjawulo alaga nti abayizi, nga mw'otwalidde n'abo abalina obulemu mu kusoma, balaga obwetaavu bw'obuyambi okusobola okutegeera omukwano oguli wakati w'ekifo n'ekikolwa, kale n'asaba okukola ebikolwa ebisooka ebyangu okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa. Okusinziira ku ebyo waggulu, nkola ki esaanidde okukozesebwa okuddamu eri embeera y'abayizi ey'okuyiga?
answer_a: Soma emboozi okuzuula omuzira omukulu, londawo ebanga n'embeera ebamwetoolodde, tegeera ebibaleetera okukola ekyo, era olonde ebipimo by'enneewulira zaabwe.
answer_b: Kola n'essuula y'ekitabo kye bagenda okusoma okutegeka ebikolwa by'abazannyi abakulu n'ebifaananyi era okutegeera ebibatuukako, ebifo we bibeera, n'abalumwa.
answer_c: Tegeka amakulu agali mu kigendererwa eky'okutuukibwako okusobola okutegeera ekifo eky'ebyogerero n'ebikolwa by'abantu abalimu, era okutegeera embeera, obudde, obuntu, ekifo ky'ebirowoozo, n'ebikolwa.
answer_d: Londaamu ebitundu okuva mu katabo akalimu ebifaananyi okusobola okulaga abantu abaliko kye bakola, we bali, era n'okutegeera engeri gye bawuliramu, ng'osinziira ku biwandiike ebiri n'ekifaananyi, endowooza z'abantu abaliko, n'ebintu ebirala ebiriwo.

question: Soma embeera eno wamanga, Leonor ali ku ddala lyakusatu naye alina obulemu mukusoma oba atawaanyizibwa mukusoma. Okusobola okufuna okuzuula ensoma etegeerekeka, omuyizi yetaaga okwenyigira era nokuteebereza obaokukuba akafaananyi ku kusoma nokuwandiika. Olwokuba enteekateeka exigoberera enkola eyekikugu tezirina kyeziyambye, omusomesa wabayizi abaliko obulemu ategeseewo engerinendala eziyinza okuyamba omuwala, okugeza entwala wamu nokusikirizibwa/ nobwagazi bwalina eri ebyo ebirabwako n' amaaso. Nga osinziira kwebyo, nkola ki eyinza okugya oba okukozesebwa ku Leonor?
answer_a: Tulabe enyingo ezisooka ku mannya tumwagazise okuziwandiika nga akola ebigambo bye nga asinziira ku zzo.
answer_b: Wetegereze bu ddole oba bupingu obwenjawulo alondeko obwo obusinze okumusanyusa era abunyonyole okusinziira kuntegeeraye nomubiri gwe era nemubuwandiike.
answer_c: Ddamu wekeneenye ebiwandiiko ebyenjawulo ebikadde, omusikirize okubinoonyerezaako era awandiike kwebyo ebirimu, nga asinziira ku nteekateeka, empandiika, enongoosereza nenfulumya y'ekiwandiiko.
answer_d: Soma ekigambo era olage ennukuta zaakyo ensirifu, omusikirize okuzikozesa okuwandiika enyingo ezenjawulo, nga tewerabidde oba nga ofaayo nti alina okumanya oba okwetegereza envuga / enjatula yaazo wamu nukuzijjukira nga akozesa obufaananyi

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Ekibiina ky'ekibiina eky'ebyafaayo,essom ly'ensi wamu sayansi w'embeera z'abantu mu kibiina ekyookuna bategeka okwanjula omulimu okulaba ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga "Funa ebifo ku maapu nga bakozesa enkizo y'ekifo nga endagiriro (Emmatinise ez'obuvanjuba n'emmattinise ez'obukiika)."Nga okukola kino, lowooza ki ku bubonero buno wammanga mu kibiina: -abayizi amakumi mu abiri. Okubaawo kwa bayizi abazuulibwa ne ADHD wamu no obulemu mu kuyiga.-Balina okwetaba n'obunyiikivu mu mirimu egy'omugaso. Baggwamu amaanyi olw'enkulaakulana y'ebigobererwa n'ennyanjula ez'omu kamwa. Okusinziira ku bubonero bwe ekibiina ekinnyonyoddwa,ngeri ki enasobezesa okwanjula omulimu okulaga ekigendererwa ky'okuyiga?
answer_a: Kozesa ekitabo ekinene eky’ebifaananyi n’abayizi, gamba ng’ekifaananyi ky’ensi yonna, basobole okunoonya amawanga ag’enjawulo ku kyo, kibasobozese okumanya ebifo byago we biraga ku maapu.
answer_b: Zannya emizannyo gy'oku kaadi n'abayizi, gamba nga, olutalo lw'amaato, basobole okuzuula ebifananyi ku lukalala lw'ebifo, kibayambe okunoonyereza ku biri mu ssomo nga tebannalitegeera bulungi.
answer_c: Kozesa ebintu bya pulasitiika ng'omupiira, abayizi basobole okukuba olukoloboze olugalamivu n'olugolokofu okukirako, nga kibasobozesa okuzuula omugaso gwabyo ku ttaka ly'ensi.
answer_d: Zannya n'abayizi okuzuula amawanga, okugeza, ku guloobu, balyoke bamanye omukutu gw'ensi n'olunyiriri lwa Greenwich, kibayambe okutegeera endowooza zino ng'ebifo eby'okutandikirako.

question: Bukodyo ki obukwata n'enkulaakulana yo omulimu ogw'okuddukanya emirimu ogw'okuteekateeka mu muyizi n'obulemu mu mutendera ogusooka mu mbeera y'ekibiina?
answer_a: Saba omuyizi akole ebintu ebyo kwejjulula ebiraga engeri gy’ebikolwa bye bwe bikosa ebintu ebirala.
answer_b: Wa wano we wetaaga okuteekawo emirimu egikubiriza omuyizi okusalawo okuyita mu bibuuzo eby'ekiggwo ebitaliiko bukomo.
answer_c: Teekawo emirimu gy’okukakasa omuyizi mw’akakasa ekintu ekikoleddwa n’agenda mu maaso mu ngeri entengejje.
answer_d: Teekawo emirimu mu biseera ebyeyongera, omuyizi mw’alina okukoppa ebimuweereddwa okusobola okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa.

question: Soma embeera eno: Sofia alina emyaka kkumi, ali mu kibiina kyakusatu, era alina obulemu mu kusoma. Mu kubala, akola ebikunizo ebiwandiike nga ayambibwa ebifaananyi era ategeera emisingi gy'okubala, ng'alaga obwetaavu bw'okuyambibwa mu kuwandiika obubonero bw'okubala. Omusomesa we omukulu akolera mu kibiina ku bukugu bw'okugonjoola ebizibu by'okugatta n'okwawuza. Okusinziira ku bubaka buno, ku bikolwa by'obusomesa bino wammanga kiki ekikulaakulanya obukugu bw'okugonjoola ebizibu by'ekibalangulo?
answer_a: Saba abayizi okuteesa embeera mwe bayinza okutekawo ebizibu by'okubala.
answer_b: Kakasa nti abayizi bategeera bulungi ebikolebwa n'ebyava mu kubala okwakolebwa emabega.
answer_c: Waayo ebibuuzo by'okubala eri abayizi bana bana, abateekwa okukola okubala n'okuwandiika ebyavudde mu kubala ku kibbali
answer_d: Kiliza engeri ez'enjawulo ez'abayizi okunnyonnyola enkola eyakozeseddwa mu kugonjoola ekizibu ky'okubala

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Oluvannyuma lw'okuyingira essomera ly'abaana abato, Camilla alina obulemu ku bwongo, era ekibinja ky'ekibiina kirina okutondawo pulogolamu ye by'enjigiriza bya sekkinoomu okukulaakulanya nga tannasoma obaobukugu mu kusoma,naddala okutegeera okulaba n'okusosolebwa,okulowooza ku by'omuyizi by'ayagala. Nga osinziira ku nkola y'okusoma okwa bulijjo,bikolwa ki wammanga ebiyinza okukulaakulanya obukugu mu kusoma mu mutendera ogusooka?
answer_a: Tondawo akatabo ko nga kalimu ebigambo ebikulu by'oyize.
answer_b: Gatta ebifaananyi by’abantu be ab’omumaka be abasinga okumpi, okuyita mu mizannyo gy’okujjukira n’eya lotto
answer_c: Kozesa kaadi eziriko ebifaananyi n'ebigambo okukwataganya ekifaananyi n'erinnya ly'omuntu wo ow'oluganda amukwatagana.
answer_d: Tegeera ebigambo eby’amaanyi mu nsi yonna, ng’okozesa amannya g’ab’oluganda lwe ab’oku lusegere ng’ebigambo by’oyiga.

question: Omusomesa wa pulayimale yalagidde abayizzi be ab'ekibiina eky'okusattu okusoma nga bwebaddamu olugero olumpi olulagibbwa ku lutimbe. Mukusooka, bali bakusoma kinnomu atte mukasirise, oluvanyumma, baatule, nga bagoberera obubonero obwempandika. Kika ki eky'okuyiga ekifuna mu mu bikolwa ebilagiddwa?
answer_a: Okukuguka mu byensoma
answer_b: Okuzzamu ammanyi okusoma okw'okutegera
answer_c: Okwekeneenya enjatula y'ebigambo
answer_d: Okummanya okusoma okw'obubonero

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Rodrigo,omuyizi omuzibe wa maaso,nga era eddaala y'okulaba kulaba ebizimba ebinene ne ebintu ebiri okumpi,ayingira mu ssomero lya abaana abato eririna enteekateeka y'okuzzaamu abantu amaanyi,okufuna ebyenjigiriza ebitongole omulundi ogusookedde ddala.Abasomesa be bakizuula nti alina enkulaakulaana ey'amakulu entono  nga bwe kitasuubirwa mu myaka gye. nga tutunuulira embeera n'obulwadde bwa Rodrigo, bubonero kiobw'okusomesa obusinga okumuyamba n'abayizi abalala bonna ku mutindo ogw'okulaakulana kwa amannya kw'ebintu ogw'ekibinja kyabwe?
answer_a: Abaana banyumya emboozi ez'enjawulo nga bakola mizannyo mu bibinja.
answer_b: Abaana bazannya okusobola okunnyonnyola n'okuzuula ebigambo ebipya okuva mu ngero.
answer_c: Abaana bakebera ebintu ebikwatika, obutindo, okubumba n'okuwa endowooza ku ngeri zaabyo.
answer_d: Abaana batambula okugenda mu bifo by'omukitundu, nga bakebera ebintu ebipya nga bakozesa okukwatako.

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga : Maria Luise muyizi mu kibiina ekyookuna ku ssomero eririna pulogulamu ly'ebinjigiriza erya buli omu. okwalaba kwe kutono oluvannyuma lw'okuzuulibwa n'obulwadde bwa 'aniridia ne' horizontal bilateral nystagmus. Mu kibiina eky'ebyafaayo,obusaamwenge,sayansi w'embeera z'abantu ekibinja okuva mu kibiina kijja kukola ne kiruubirirwa eky'okuyiga: okugeraageeranya okubaawo kw'engeri z'omubiri n'ez'obutonde(okugeza ensozi,emigga,eddungu,biici,embeera y'obudde n'ebirala bingi) mu bifo eby'enjawulo  ebirika obulungi mu kitundu kye. Mu kino ekibinja ky'ekibiina kyetaaga okutegeka engeri y'okulaba nga eyamba Maria Luisa okwetabamu. Ngeri ki enaasobozesa  Maria Luisa okwetaabamu n'okutuuka ku kiruubirirwa?
answer_a: Laga, okuyita mu by'okumuwulira, ebika by'obuyitiro bw'ettaka eby'enjawulo.
answer_b: Teeka ebifaananyi ebiraga ebika by'enkula y'ettaka eby'enjawulo nga byeyambisiddwa ebintu ebikwatika
answer_c: Kola kaadi ezirambika ezannyonnyola buli kika kya ndabika y'ensi.
answer_d: Zimba omulengo ogulina obubonero obukwatika ogukozesa ebika by'enkula y'ettaka eby'enjawulo.

question: Amalia omuyizi o'wemyaka ena yazuulibwan'obuzibumu lulimi olw'okwolesa nga era abeera mu ssomero ly'olulimu .Omusomesa atangaaza obwagazi bwalina mu kwetaba mu kibiina naye obuzibu buli ku nkulaakulaana yo lulimi lwe era kizuulidddwa nti tasobola kwenkanyankanya byetaago by'oyo gwayogera naye era tassaamu kitiibwa ku nkyukakyukamu kibuuzo n'okuddamu. Okwongerezaako,bwayogera, ennukuta "r"tagiteeka mu kigambo tamenyarawo biti bya makulu era tannayogera sentesi eziragira n'ezobukakafu.Okusinziira ku myaka gya Amalia mutendera gwa lulimi ki obuyambi bwe bwetaagisa mu bulabikira.
answer_a: Amakulu g'ebigambo
answer_b: Eby'amaloboozi
answer_c: Ekikolwa ekigendereddwa
answer_d: Enkola y'ebigambo n'engeri gye bikolamu sentensi

question: Soma embeera eno: Gabriela muyizi wa pulayimale ey’okuna mu ssomero eririna ekitongole ekirabirira abantu abekikula kyonna, era alina obuzibu mu nk'ozesa eyebigambo.
